protocol.name: TBBT independent qualified-control natural experiment
protocol.pre_outcome_amendment: Version 1 pre-period diagnostics showed that simplex weights on unscaled community volumes cannot compare communities of different size, and that a point-null pretrend test rejects practically negligible slopes. Version 2 standardized donors and adopted a prespecified equivalence interval. Version 2 pre-period diagnostics then exposed a measurement-source mismatch: TBBT treated counts were being fitted to Arctic Shift donor counts. Version 3 uses Arctic Shift for both treated and donor outcomes while retaining TBBT for intervention definitions and independent source-overlap auditing. Version 3 pre-period diagnostics showed that an absolute NRMSE threshold of 0.45 lacked a reference prediction. Version 4 requires validation and pre-period RMSPE to improve on the historical-mean predictor. No post-treatment estimate was inspected for these amendments.
protocol.estimand: Average log change in daily within-community comment volume relative to a pre-outcome synthetic donor pool.
protocol.selection_rule: Interventions and donor candidates are fixed before post-treatment outcomes are evaluated.
protocol.reporting_rule: All eligible interventions, failed gates, estimates, intervals, and placebo diagnostics are retained.
protocol.control_rule: TBBT OUT slices are affected-user activity and are never used as untreated controls. Treated and donor outcome series are measured by the same Arctic Shift endpoint.
